Bill.BriefDescription: Changing the effective date of the uniform interstate family support act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the uniform interstate family support act; andamending RCW 26.21A.900.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 26.21A.900 and 2002 c 198 s 906 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This act takes effect six months after (1) the amendment bycongress to 42 U.S.C. Sec. 666(f) authorizing or mandating states toadopt this version of the uniform interstate family support act or (2)the grant to the state of Washington of a federal waiver of theprovisions of 42 U.S.C. Sec. 666(f), whichever occurs first.
